# Youxiang Jiang

<div class="name-cn">姜有祥</div>

<div class="role">Ph.D. in Psychology (Psychometrics)<br>Psychometric Researcher</div>

<div class="contact-inline"><a href="mailto:jiangyouxiang34@163.com">Email ↗</a> <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4557-5038">ORCID ↗</a> <a href="https://github.com/jiangyouxiang">GitHub ↗</a></div>

::: {.hero-statement}
## Measurement theory and assessment technology for psychological and educational research.

I study how measurement models can better represent response processes and support efficient assessment.

我的研究关注连续有界反应、异常作答与反应风格、计算机自适应测验，以及 AI 辅助测评。
:::
:::

::: {.academic-section #research}
::: {.section-heading}
## Research
<span>研究方向</span>
:::
::: {.research-list}
::: {.research-item}
<span class="item-no">01</span>
<h3>Psychometric modeling</h3>
<p>项目反应理论、连续有界反应模型与认知诊断模型。</p>
:::
::: {.research-item}
<span class="item-no">02</span>
<h3>Response processes</h3>
<p>异常作答、反应风格、社会称许性和反应时建模。</p>
:::
::: {.research-item}
<span class="item-no">03</span>
<h3>Adaptive assessment</h3>
<p>计算机自适应测验、题目选择策略与语言能力测评。</p>
:::
::: {.research-item}
<span class="item-no">04</span>
<h3>AI-assisted assessment</h3>
<p>大语言模型在题目生成、交互式测评和数据分析中的应用。</p>
:::
:::
:::
